column2: Used to skipping meals; it barely registers.
Another frustrating commute that I'm used to.
Shrugs and handles it automatically. Almost upon reflex.
No Shame, I am long past caring what others think.
Used to pushing personal pain aside.
Processed grief long ago; withdraws quietly.
Sits with the pain but remains functional.
Talks plainly. He's survived this long.
However imperfect, the coping mechanisms have yet to fail.
